description.value:
Using your bonus action, you can begin a coordinated maneuver with an ally within 5 feet of you. For the next minute, as long as you and that ally stay within 5 feet of each other and neither of you wields a shield, you each gain a bonus to AC equal to half your proficiency bonus.

When your chosen ally moves on their turn, you may spend your reaction to move alongside them, ending your movement within 5 feet of them; this movement can't exceed your own speed.

The effect ends early if either of you is incapacitated or dies. Once used, this feature requires a long rest before you can use it again.
